title: Cancellation Age and the Plan's Request History — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**For an Alignment Services & Plans plan, the date the cancellation age runs to follows the plan's request history.** The cancellation age is counted in calendar days from the plan's purchase date, and the processing fee is read from the same age bands at whichever date applies: 20.00 at an age of at least 21 days, 10.00 at an age of at least 11 and below 21 days, and 0.00 below 11 days.

| Request awaiting the holder's confirmation was registered | Plan's request history | The cancellation age runs to |
|---|---|---|
| no more than 7 calendar days before the cancellation date | the plan has a withdrawn request registered on or before the day the request awaiting confirmation was registered | the registration date of the latest such withdrawn request |
| no more than 7 calendar days before the cancellation date | the plan has no such withdrawn request | the registration date of the request awaiting confirmation |
| more than 7 calendar days before the cancellation date | — | the cancellation date |

### Worked cases (hypothetical plan bought on day 0, cancelled on day 24)
- Request awaiting confirmation registered on day 19 (5 days before), a request registered on day 9 was withdrawn: age runs to day 9 → 9 days → fee 0.00.
- Request registered on day 19, nothing withdrawn: age runs to day 19 → 19 days → fee 10.00.
- Request registered on day 16 (8 days before): age runs to day 24 → 24 days → fee 20.00.
- Request registered on day 17 (exactly 7 days before), nothing withdrawn: age runs to day 17 → fee 10.00.
